Installing this bundle auto-installs all four presets (v1 was removed at v2.0.0). Each preset also writes a FINAL PAPER by default when its run concludes — and does so BEFORE the run is marked complete: on v4/v5 the team co-authors its parts, merges them, cross-reviews, and the editor named by paperEditor finalises; the output is Paper/<run or institute id>/{paper.md,paper.tex,paper.pdf when a LaTeX engine is detected,paper.meta.json,paper.log.md} (params finalPaper/paperFormat/paperLanguage/paperCompilePdf/paperLatexCommand, plus paperEditor on v4/v5; see docs/final-paper.md).

description.en: Exposes a single sleep tool that lets the model pause for a configurable number of milliseconds before returning — handy for waiting out time-based conditions (service restarts, debounce windows, retry backoff) when no event-driven tool fits. Over-long durations are clamped to maxDurationMs; mid-sleep cancellation resolves with cancelled: true instead of throwing.
description.zh: 向模型暴露一个 sleep 工具：按指定毫秒数暂停后再返回，适合等待服务重启、debounce 窗口、retry backoff 等时间相关条件。超过上限的时长会被钳制；中途取消以 cancelled: true 正常返回而不抛错。

description.en: Lets read / write / edit handle non-UTF-8 files correctly — GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR and more: writes go back in the original encoding with bytes, line endings and BOM preserved, and an uncertain guess lists the candidates for you to pick.
description.zh: 让 read / write / edit 正确读写 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS、EUC-KR 等非 UTF-8 文件：按原编码回写，字节、换行与 BOM 原样保留；编码不确定时列出候选供你选择。
